title: Standard and small crane comparison
slide_intent: Compare optical variants because a mark needs different detail treatment at different reproduction sizes.
strategic_value: A small-use crane can help Lufthansa retain recognizable detail when the standard drawing loses clarity.
demonstration: A two-frame animation keeps the outline comparison at left and switches the filled right specimen between Standard and Small.
practical_value: Choose a size-specific drawing by comparing ring weight and internal openings, without inventing a size threshold.

content_islands.spec: Keep the pale filled standard and outlined small drawings together at left.

content_islands.name: Alternating specimen
content_islands.spec: Switch the right filled crane and its Standard or Small label in place.
